_comment: Findings from pipeline/geometry_gates.py that are known and still outstanding. Listed here they report but do not fail the build; anything NOT listed fails. Each line needs the פמ"ת row to resolve, not a code change. Shrinking this file is the goal — when a key stops firing, validate.py says so and it should be deleted.

known.dup-code:LLU_KOCHAV_YAIR: same code in both files with centres ~500 m apart, so one of the two positions is wrong; needs the פמ"ת row to decide which
known.shape-vs-text:LLU_KOCHAV_YAIR: notes call it a קשת (arc); stored as a full circle, which over-covers
known.shape-vs-text:LLU_NATAF: notes call it a קשת ברדיוס 1.5 ק"מ; stored as a full circle, which over-covers
known.shape-vs-text:LLD28: גליל הצנחה חוף התמרים is a חצי מעגל צפוני in the notes but a whole circle in the geometry — double the real area
known.same-geom:LLD37|LLD38: מחניים מערב and מחניים מזרח are the west and east halves of one parachuting cylinder; both are stored as the same full 2.5 km circle
known.self-intersect:LLP16: עין עבדת outline crosses itself. Worst of the four: the code starts with LLP1, so the app treats it as an ordered path and skips the angle sort, meaning the bowtie is what tap detection and route-conflict checks actually use
known.self-intersect:LLR01: outline crosses itself; the app angle-sorts LLR zones at runtime, which hides it but produces a star-convex outline rather than the true one
known.self-intersect:LLR02: outline crosses itself; same runtime angle-sort caveat as LLR01
known.self-intersect:LLU_BERESHIT_101: outline crosses itself; same runtime angle-sort caveat
